# descope_outbound_app (Data Source)

Reads an existing outbound application in a Descope project, and fails when the project has no outbound application with the given ID. Use it to depend on an application that is managed outside of Terraform, such as one whose client secret is entered in the Descope console.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the outbound application.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project this outbound application belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `app_type` (String) The kind of credential the application holds, either `oauth` or `apikey`.
- `description` (String) The description of the outbound application.
- `name` (String) The name of the outbound application.
